crossRefs.note: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your…
He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, wallet, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”
Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.
Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money…
but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.
No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining…
But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists, and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much…

translations.web: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two coats each.
translations.bsb: “Take nothing for the journey,” He told them, “no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no second tunic.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staff, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money; neither have two coats.
